title: Decision: the plain IRC listener may bind any address; the operator controls exposure. Supersedes mimid-1wgh.91, amends client-survey.md S1 for IRC
description:
Mark, 2026-11-22: 'now, i want unencrypted irc to just work. i know how to run iptables and proxies myself.'

SUPERSEDES mimid-1wgh.91 (same day), which allowed plaintext IRC only on a tailnet address verified by Tailscale WhoIs. That exception is moot: any address is now allowed, so a tailnet address is allowed without asking tailscaled anything. mimid-e13m.13, its implementation bead, is closed unstarted.

AMENDS client-survey.md S1 for IRC only. S1 said a non-loopback listener 'refuses to start without TLS'. For [irc] listen that no longer holds. S1 stands unchanged for the agent's HTTP listener (JMAP Chat), which keeps ConfigError::NotLoopback: NOT decided here, and Mark has not asked for it.

CHOSEN. [irc] listen accepts any address. The default is unchanged (127.0.0.1:6667), so nothing moves unless the operator writes another address. No opt-in flag, no acknowledgement prompt: 'just work' means no friction. listen_tls keeps working and still requires [tls].

AUTHENTICATION IS UNCHANGED AND STILL MANDATORY. A credential (the local token or an app password) by SASL PLAIN, SASL SCRAM-SHA-256 or PASS, checked against the stored SCRAM-SHA-256 verifiers before registration ends, with per-source slowdown on failures. Unencrypted, not unauthenticated.

RISK ACCEPTED, STATED ONCE. On a plain listener off loopback, message bodies are cleartext on the wire, and PASS and SASL PLAIN put the credential there too; SASL SCRAM-SHA-256 avoids the credential but not the bodies. Mark controls exposure with iptables and proxies and has accepted this explicitly. mimid must not claim otherwise anywhere: the agent is no longer 'plaintext only on loopback'.

WHAT IT CHANGES. Enforcement removed: mimid-agent config.rs check() (ConfigError::IrcNotLoopback, variant deleted), mimid-agent-irc listen.rs bind (IrcError::NotLoopback, variant deleted) and the accept loop's is_loopback drop, which would otherwise refuse every connection to the new address. Tests that asserted refusal become tests that assert acceptance: front_end_auth.rs and config.rs. Documents restated: AGENTS.md (the mimid-agent and mimid-agent-irc crate-map rows, and the security-invariant table's agent IRC boundary), frontend-auth.md, client-survey.md S1, mimid-agent-irc lib.rs and listen.rs module docs, mimid-agent config.rs module docs.
